annotations.title: Build a snippet from a layout

description: Build an InDesign snippet (.idms) with the objects of one page of a layout description (see read_layout for the format). Paragraph styles, character styles, object styles and swatches are written as empty shells with their names, so the definitions of the same name in the target document apply; frames of one story are threaded. fit fill|proportional|trim_box computes scale and offset of images and PDFs from the file (pixel size and resolution, MediaBox/TrimBox); an image stored with an EXIF orientation other than 1 gets a warning, because it can appear turned. Returns path, objects, stories, paragraph_styles, character_styles, swatches and bounds_mm. With place_on_page_id the snippet is placed right away as with place_snippet; the answer then carries placed.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used.

layer.description: Layer (Ebene) for the placed objects. Default: the active layer.

layout.description: Layout description as JSON: {spreads: [{parents: [prefix per page], objects: [...]}, or {from_template: "<page name>"}], stories: {key: [{style, runs: [{text, character_style, local}], local}]}}; a single spread may also be given as {pages, objects, stories}. Objects: {type text|image|pdf|rectangle|placeholder|raw, page (0-based within the spread), x, y, width, height in mm from the top left corner of that page, rotation 0|90|270, story (text), file plus fit fill|proportional|trim_box or scale, offset_mm, graphic_bounds_pt (image, pdf), fill, tint, stroke, stroke_weight_pt, object_style, layer, text_wrap, frame_options (IDML TextFramePreference attributes such as TextColumnCount, TextColumnGutter in pt), inset_pt, chain_index}. Styles and swatches are referenced by name (ParagraphStyle reference as in IDML, e.g. "Group%3aName" for a style in a group). Measures are used unrounded. read_layout returns this format; the German keys of earlier layout files (seiten, objekte, boegen, typ, b, h …) are accepted too.

layout_path.description: Path of a .json file with the layout description, instead of layout.

output_path.description: Target .idms path. Default: a new file in the temporary folder.

place_on_page_id.description: Place the snippet on this page right away (page_id from list_pages).

position_mm.description: Top left corner of all placed objects together, in mm from the top left corner of the page. Without it the objects keep their position from the layout (their page position).

name: build_snippet
title: Build a snippet from a layout
